title: Interactive Backdoor Attacks in LLM-Based Proactive Dialogue Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.06969v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-based proactive dialogue systems provide goal-directed support through sustained interaction. Fine-tuning their underlying models on externally supplied dialogue data introduces backdoor risks. Existing LLM backdoor studies primarily focus on eliciting an attacker-specified response upon trigger activation. We present an interactive backdoor attack framework that uses training-data poisoning to steer post-trigger, multi-turn interactions toward an attacker-specified objective. Poisoned fine-tuning dialogues implant a trigger-conditioned guidance-policy bias that ordinary user utterances can activate, without deployment-time prompt modification or further attacker intervention. Specifically, we instantiate three complementary attacks under progressively expanded post-trigger interaction settings: (1) Direct Attack, which targets an immediate response deviation upon trigger activation, retaining the conventional trigger--response set

translated_title: 基于大语言模型的主动对话系统中的交互式后门攻击
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型的主动对话系统通过持续的交互提供面向目标的支持。在外部提供的对话数据上对底层模型进行微调会引入后门风险。现有的大语言模型后门研究主要关注在触发器激活时诱发攻击者指定的响应。我们提出了一个交互式后门攻击框架，利用训练数据投毒将触发后的多轮交互引导至攻击者指定的目标。被投毒的微调对话会植入一种由触发条件引导的策略偏差，普通用户的话语即可将其激活，而无需在部署时修改提示词，也无需攻击者的进一步干预。具体而言，我们在逐步扩展的触发后交互设置下实例化了三种互补的攻击：（1）直接攻击，其目标是触发器激活时立即产生响应偏离，保留了传统的“触发-响应”设置（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种针对大语言模型主动对话系统的交互式后门攻击框架，通过训练数据投毒植入触发条件下的引导策略偏差，使普通用户话语即可将触发后的多轮交互引导至攻击者指定目标，无需部署时修改提示词或攻击者进一步干预。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an interactive backdoor attack framework for LLM-based proactive dialogue systems that implants a trigger-conditioned guidance-policy bias through training-data poisoning, allowing ordinary user utterances to steer post-trigger multi-turn interactions toward attacker-specified objectives without deployment-time prompt modification or further attacker intervention.
